subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(**Note: **The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) NK-PL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72faa93f6c97099d9c2b7dc094b25be86b00a4cb5a84a1bd3939aeab7ca64696.png] 

Option 2) **JG-LI**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d045f39d0deab45f41e76142ea0f0e3bb888c0a2ef736f25db32796e0ed56425.png] 

Option 3) FC-HD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de7d95f067e1feb721a1ecfe6fdbabfcf184ee57b512574374f31c6033fed072.png] 

Option 4) RO-TP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5dfa8cb3673319715b74a416f2ba23199b327db213d37d401a0911e6c660a6f9.png] 

Here, '**RO-TP**' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
